identity_short_rule_v2.added: GT24-C01 round 4, 2026-11-01, after the 58-trial pilot, before the E1 census
identity_short_rule_v2.reason: All 6 non-exact pilot trials were short stairs trials with 96-176 top-quartile samples, below the v1 minimum of 200; no identity failure was seen. True identities reached a relative spread of 6.6e-13 in the pilot. Short columns are admitted only under a gate about 1e6 tighter than v1, a second exact identity (power) and cross-joint agreement, and are labelled separately so they are never counted as v1 exact.
identity_short_rule_v2.label: exact_short
